records.jp: 「私は世界を守った」
records.en_original: I saved the world.
records.en: I saved the world.

records.jp: 「守った……はずだった」
records.en_original: At least, I thought I did.
records.en: At least, I thought I did.

records.jp: 「あの日から世界は永遠に変わってしまった」
records.en_original: But from that day on, the world was changed forever.
records.en: But from that day on, the world was changed forever.

records.jp: 「世界は今、崩壊に向かっている」
records.en_original: The world is now heading toward collapse.
records.en: The world is now heading toward collapse.

records.jp: 「お願い。あなたの力を貸してほしい」
records.en_original: Please. I need your help.
records.en: Please. I need your help.

records.jp: 「あなたなら、きっと――」
records.en_original: If it's you, I know you can—
records.en: If it's you, I know you can—

records.jp: わたしは、この世界を終了するために生まれた
records.en_original: I was born to bring this world to an end.
records.en: I was born to bring this world to an end.

records.jp: そして、この世界の中枢“コモン”へ到達する為に、<CR>その足がかりとして、あなたに近づいた
records.en_original: And in order to reach the heart of this world, the Common, I got closer to you with the intent to use you as a stepping stone.
records.en: And in order to reach the heart of this world, the Common, I got closer to you with the intent to use you as a stepping stone.

records.jp: チームメイト７人を踏み台にした
records.en_original: I used my seven teammates as pawns.
records.en: I used my seven teammates as pawns.

records.jp: それでもあなたは、<CR>わたしを好きでいてくれるというの？
records.en_original: Even after all that, you still care about me?
records.en: Even after all that, you still care about me?

records.jp: この世界にとっての破滅の神でも、<CR>変わらず愛してくれるというんですか？
records.en_original: Even if I'm a god of destruction in this world, will you still love me just the same?
records.en: Even if I'm a god of destruction in this world, will you still love me just the same?

records.jp: 事の発端は、１年半前。<CR>その日、世界に突如として『灰』が降り始めた
records.en_original: It all started a year and a half ago. That day, the "Ash" suddenly began to fall on the world.
records.en: It all started a year and a half ago. That day, the "Ash" suddenly began to fall on the world.

records.jp: ただの自然現象の一つ。<CR>当初、わたしたちはそう思っていた
records.en_original: Just another natural phenomenon—or so we thought at first.
records.en: Just another natural phenomenon—or so we thought at first.

records.jp: だけど、やがてその灰が、<CR>人体を侵す有害な物質だと知ることになる――
records.en_original: But before long, we came to learn that the Ash was a toxic substance that would invade the human body, resulting in...
records.en: But before long, we came to learn that the Ash was a toxic substance that would invade the human body, resulting in...

records.jp: 『異灰』
records.en_original: The Testa.
records.en: The Testa.

records.jp: それは、わたしたちの身体を蝕むだけでなく、<CR>異形の生物となって、襲いかかってきた
records.en_original: Not only did it eat away at our bodies, it came alive as twisted monsters and attacked us.
records.en: Not only did it eat away at our bodies, it came alive as twisted monsters and attacked us.

records.jp: 『異灰』と呼ばれるそれを倒すには、力が必要だった。<CR>灰に侵されることでごく希に発生する、『特別』な力が
records.en_original: To defeat the Testa, we needed power. A special power that sometimes, rarely, awakened in those tainted by the Ash.
records.en: To defeat the Testa, we needed power. A special power that sometimes, rarely, awakened in those tainted by the Ash.

records.jp: その力を持った存在のことを、<CR>わたしたちは畏敬の念を持って、こう呼んだ
records.en_original: We revered those who possessed that power, calling them—
records.en: We revered those who possessed that power, calling them—

records.jp: 『イローデッド』――。
records.en_original: The Eroded.
records.en: The Eroded.

records.jp: 何か歪みが発生してるせい？<CR>いつもと違うみたいだけど……
records.en_original: Is there some kind of distortion happening? Something feels different this time...
records.en: Is there some kind of distortion happening? Something feels different this time...

records.jp: でも……嫌な違和感じゃない。<CR>なんとなく、上手くいく。そんな気がする
records.en_original: But...it's not a bad feeling. Somehow, I just know things are going to go well.
records.en: But...it's not a bad feeling. Somehow, I just know things are going to go well.

records.jp: 顔は一緒……今回も男の子なのね
records.en_original: The same face as always... And this time, it's a boy again.
records.en: The same face as always... And this time, it's a boy again.

records.jp: あれは“コズミックファング”。<CR>この世界の心臓ともいうべきもの
records.en_original: That's the "Cosmic Fang." You could say it's the beating heart of this world.
records.en: That's the "Cosmic Fang." You could say it's the beating heart of this world.

records.jp: ……おぞましい姿。<CR>まるで、地獄から這い出てきた魔物のよう
records.en_original: What a monstrous sight. Like a demon that crawled out of hell.
records.en: What a monstrous sight. Like a demon that crawled out of hell.

records.jp: 改めて背筋が凍る。もうこの世界は、<CR>こんなところまで来てしまっているのね……
records.en_original: A chill is running down my spine all over again. So the world has already reached this state...
records.en: A chill is running down my spine all over again. So the world has already reached this state...

records.jp: ごめんなさい、一人で話してしまって。<CR>私は来夢
records.en_original: Sorry, I was rambling to myself. My name's Lime.
records.en: Sorry, I was rambling to myself. My name's Lime.

records.jp: わたし“たち”は、あなたが来るのを待っていた
records.en_original: We've been waiting for you to arrive.
records.en: We've been waiting for you to arrive.

records.jp: この地の異灰を殲滅するために、<CR>遠い学校から転入してきた、イローデッドの男の子
records.en_original: You're an Eroded who transferred here from a distant school, in order to rid this land of the Testa.
records.en: You're an Eroded who transferred here from a distant school, in order to rid this land of the Testa.

records.jp: あなたはこの地を……ううん、この<CR>灰に埋もれた世界“全て”を浄化できるかもしれない人
records.en_original: You just might be the one who can cleanse this place—no, the entire world from Ash.
records.en: You just might be the one who can cleanse this place—no, the entire world from Ash.

records.jp: けどそれは、あなたの力というより――
records.en_original: But more than your own strength—
records.en: But more than your own strength—

records.jp: これから共に異灰と闘うことになる、<CR>イローデッドの少女たちにかかっている
records.en_original: It actually depends on the Eroded girls who will fight the Testa alongside you from now on.
records.en: It actually depends on the Eroded girls who will fight the Testa alongside you from now on.

records.jp: 彼女たちはまだ、殻に閉じこもったまま。<CR>それを開花させることができるのが、あなたなの
records.en_original: They're still shut away in their shells. Only you can help them bloom.
records.en: They're still shut away in their shells. Only you can help them bloom.

records.jp: あなたには、期待しているから
records.en_original: We're counting on you.
records.en: We're counting on you.

records.jp: 大丈夫……大丈夫だから。<CR>頑張れ、わたし……
records.en_original: It's okay... It's gonna be okay. Come on, Shiho, you can do this.
records.en: It's okay... It's gonna be okay. Come on, Shiho, you can do this.

records.jp: あっ、ごめんなさい。<CR>こんな所にいたら、邪魔ですよね！
records.en_original: Ah, sorry! I'm in the way, aren't I?
records.en: Ah, sorry! I'm in the way, aren't I?

records.jp: え、えっと……、わたし、今日転校してきて……。<CR>だから、ちゃんと馴染めるか心配で……
records.en_original: Uh, um... I just transferred here today, so I'm kinda worried about fitting in...
records.en: Uh, um... I just transferred here today, so I'm kinda worried about fitting in...

records.jp: 「楽しみなことを考え続けてると叶いやすくなる」
records.en_original: Just keep thinking about things you're looking forward to.
records.en: Just keep thinking about things you're looking forward to.

records.jp: 楽しみなことを……
records.en_original: Things I'm looking forward to...
records.en: Things I'm looking forward to...

records.jp: ふふっ、それ、素敵ですね。<CR>なんだか、そう考えてたら元気になってきました！
records.en_original: Hehe, that's really wonderful. Just thinking about it like that is making me feel a lot better!
records.en: Hehe, that's really wonderful. Just thinking about it like that is making me feel a lot better!

records.jp: あ、あの、ありがとうございます！
records.en_original: Um, th-thank you so much!
records.en: Um, th-thank you so much!
